summary: Zamboanga Sibugay 1st District representative with 115 principal-authored bills. Authored an anti-dynasty ban, barangay term limits and occupational safety standards, and co-authored a teacher pay increase. Only the economic dimension reached two issues. Democratic-institutions evidence is a single issue (limits on entrenched incumbency).
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced from 115. Anti-dynasty and term limits treated as one issue, so democratic score withheld.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored occupational safety and health standards (-2); co-authored higher minimum salaries for public school teachers (-2). Labor and public-service issues only; no tax or privatization evidence.
